messages.subject: colorspace input ? Qual possible ?
parts:
Hi,

just a quick check when dealing with old SOLiD colorspace data - it seems only -r should be used to input the .csfasta files, and the .qual files are not used (based on the answer and example command line in this forum on subjunc ). Is this true ?

It seems like subread might be a long term alternative to the commercial novoalignCS for dealing with legacy SOLiD data.

Thanks!
Colin

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: colorspace input ? Qual possible ?
parts:
Hi Colin,

You are right -- both subread-align and subjunc don't use the ".qual" files associated with the color-space sequencing data. For the base-space sequencing data, although the quality strings are written into the BAM or SAM files, our mapping algorithm doesn't take the base quality into account. The only use of the quality strings is in our exactSNP program -- low quality bases can be optionally ignored for SNP calling.

Cheers,
Yang
